layoutNote: Plate V ll. 13–30 (pp. 20–22), heading "PLATE VI." on p. 23, Plate VI ll. 31–44 (pp. 23–24). Rubric (overlined): p. 22 last row over setekeni baiu (the rule begins just after à); p. 23 l. 31 menχu em pa; l. 34 from à to the row end and pa at the start of the next row; the whole row of ll. 36–37 (à … baiu); l. 37 next row menχu em pa en; none on p. 24. Line numerals printed inside words are given the line in which the word begins: sebàu (22), seqai (25), Seker (28), χebasi (29), maa-f (32), ḥems-ten (33), mātennu (38), śem-f (42); "18." falls between Budge's "...." and tu, which are separate groups. Square brackets in the hieroglyph line: neter (R8, l. 39), un-f (l. 43, part), sep-[f] (I9, l. 44), flagged restored. Budge's "...." (l. 16 before Reχtet; l. 17 twice) = groups he leaves unread; their signs are coded. Budge's dotted Ṭeṭṭeṭi / Ṭeṭṭeṭu followed as printed (all four t's dotted). Small × marks: the horns of the viper I9, except Z9 inside seś, śeta, àpui, àpu. Kneeling figure with hand to mouth A2, as in ani-001-a; R7 printed at the foot left of the jabiru in ba / baiu, coded first.
